text_block_list.text:
One of the elements
that proves one is "the strongest"—

And that is defeating the "strongest" rival
of her era.
An undisputed ruler who challenged the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe as a Classic Triple Crown Umamusume—Orfevre.

With her outlandish ideas and otherworldly toughness,
she took the racing world by storm and showed her power—
Classic Double Crown Umamusume: Gold Ship.
Having bested both of them directly, Gentildonna truly became the strongest Umamusume of her era—
I was looking for a new thrill.

text_block_list.name: Ring Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes, here it comes! Moa Meha's finishing moveâ
A big wave crashing down from the top rope!
Volcanic! Dropkiiiiiiiiick!!

text_block_list.name: Ring Announcer
text_block_list.text: Pure artistry! This is Umamusume pro wrestling!! A clean hit right to Mallard's face! Moa Meha casually moves in for the cover—

text_block_list.name: Ring Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—After a 50-minute deathmatch, right now!
The fated showdown has finally come to an end...!

Today, I came to watch an Umamusume pro wrestling
event that Gentildonna's family business invests in.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Their bodies are different
from us racing Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Some focus solely on bulking up,
while others optimize for rope work...
In a way, they are truly challenging the limits of the physical body.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
When two mighty forces clash against each other,
how could it be anything less than thrilling?
choice_data_list: So, did you feel the heat?
So, did you feel the heat?

text_block_list.text:
It happened one day during a short break
to refresh after the fierce battle of the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —...How boring.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
No race plans for a while.
Hard training is forbidden too...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I naturally understand the logic behind settling the score built up over these three years.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
However, after running
such an intense race...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You can leave right away, yes?
I have an idea in mind.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: “—I thought watching something that inspired me in the past might help, but...”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Watching such a fierce battle only makes me thirst all the more.
Indeed, I...
choice_data_list: You want to pit your strength against them, don't you?
You want to pit your strength against them, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Since you understand, does that mean
I can get my hopes up?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying you will present me
with a peerless, exquisite thrill?

"I had a feeling Gentildonna would get bored
without a fierce clash of power."

What brings Gentildonna the greatest joy—
lies, without a doubt, in battle against the truly strong.
choice_data_list: There just happens to be a girl looking for you.
There just happens to be a girl looking for you.

text_block_list.text: She had contacted that girl and prepared a stage for their showdown.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I can make a good guess, but...
Just who is this daredevil, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: So you've arrived.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
We have been expecting you,
Gentil-san.

The one waiting was Orfevre.
Her elder sister, Dream Journey, was with her today as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I've gone four for four against you...
Beating you thoroughly every time, though."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "I shall repay that debt without fail. For now... I grant you the honor of playing with the King."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Anyone calling themselves a lady
would naturally possess an aptitude for golf.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Of course.
—If only it ends as mere child's play, though.
And so, with myself and Dream Journey serving as caddies, the golf showdown between Gentildonna and Orfevre began.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—That's quite a match.
Both of them seem to be having fun.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I was the one who suggested a golf showdown to Orfevre... and it turned out to be the right call.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like frustration had been building up lately.
...Looks like we can blow it all away in one go.

I sense a hidden meaning behind Dream Journey's gentle words...
Most likely, those she plans to blow away include Gentildonna as well—
choice_data_list: …Heavy enough to get blown away, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh. ...It looks like quite a challenge,
but Orfevre will surely see it through. Fufufu...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I wonder whose battle this is.
Hoho...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Peace-peace!
There you are, Gentile!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I knew it was you,
Gold Ship-san."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, heard you're bored out of your mind?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that literally the worst hell in this world!
Golshi-chan seriously feels for ya.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And that's the deal.
Let's dive in!

When I brought the topic up to Gold Ship,
she did say we'd be arm wrestling.
I thought that would put less strain on her, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Could you say that to a blue whale's face?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it's winter or a dream, you're swimming your heart out, right?
That's what living is all about! Burn even hotter!"
However, no matter how tough and formidable Gentildonna may be, midwinter swimming carries a high risk.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heeey.
...Wanna taste a dropkick?
I recall that vicious dropkick from the Umamusume pro wrestling match earlier... Even if I end up on the receiving end of one—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...I see a boat over there.
Is that not yours?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you noticed!
A sailor buddy of mine said he'd lend it to us.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I call her the S.S. Blue Whale!
Let's head to Treasure Island! Let's play baseball—!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
If I had to say, then...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You merely showed your resolve.
...Is that not sufficient?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: So you're here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You're late!
My eyes dried out waiting for you."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho...
I knew it was you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So, with the two losers lined up before me,
how do you plan to delight me?

Gentildonna has claimed decisive GⅠ victories over
both Orfevre and Gold Ship. Even so, the fire within
them continues to burn.
choice_data_list: Wanna race in the VR world?
Do you want to race in the VR world?

text_block_list.text: The academy has a machine that loads the Umamusume's data to perform various tasks in VR space. By using it, one can run while letting their body rest.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Consider this a rehearsal before I break you
on the real turf. ...Let us see if you can entertain me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey.
What exactly are you plotting?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A VR space that could never rival reality...
Yet the opponent had already conquered it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You could not be foolish enough to think
I would be satisfied under such conditions.
choice_data_list: Now test your strength against me too, Gentil!
You're up against me too, Gentil!

text_block_list.text: Using Gentildonna as the base for physical ability, I prepared an Umamusume model infused with everything I have to offer as a Trainer.
choice_data_list: Can you surpass the ultimate combo, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe.
Hehehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —My, what a delightful person you are!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
This looks like it'll be the ultimate thrill.
—I'll blow them all away.
